theorem lg_target : StrictMonoOn Int.natAbs (Set.Ici 0) := by
  unfold StrictMonoOn
  intros x y hxy
  have hx : 0 ≤ x := Set.Ici.mem_iff.1 x
  have hy : 0 ≤ y := Set.Ici.mem_iff.1 y
  have h1 : Int.natAbs x = x := Int.natAbs_of_nonneg hx
  have h2 : Int.natAbs y = y := Int.natAbs_of_nonneg hy
  rw [h1, h2]
  exact hxy
